args.sql:
SELECT 
    e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' as industry_code,
    COUNT(*) as application_numbers,
    SUM(cw.wsheads) as total_workforce,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(cw.wsheads), 0), 2) as percentage
FROM cases c
JOIN employer e ON c.homefirm = e.corphandle
LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON c.filekey = cw.dockkey
WHERE e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.employer_contact_info->>'naics_code'
HAVING ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(cw.wsheads), 0), 2) > 15
ORDER BY percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
